notes: Recovered preflight executed successfully with four non-corpus inputs, valid normalized vectors, and correct basic semantic ordering. This registration does not select Ollama, all-minilm, MariaDB embedding storage, PHP cosine retrieval, or any final AI architecture. Full-corpus attempt TR-EMB-FULL-001 used Ollama 0.32.1 with the same all-minilm model digest and settings. The run failed safely after 43 of 101 vectors when CH-FX-DOCX-006-001 was rejected for exceeding the effective input context length. The candidate remained unresolved after the failed full-corpus attempt and required a separate context-fit diagnostic; it was neither selected nor finally rejected at that checkpoint. Context-fit diagnostic TR-EMB-CONTEXT-001 completed all 101 accepted chunks: 100 were compatible and one was rejected. The raw diagnostic recorded HTTP 400 for CH-FX-DOCX-006-001; registered TR-EMB-FULL-001 evidence corroborates the cause as input context length exceeded. Three accepted chunks had at least 1179 characters and 18 accepted chunks had at least 162 words, so character count or word count alone does not define a reliable safe boundary. A separate model-aware, versioned segmentation correction must be reviewed before a new full-corpus run. The candidate remains unresolved and retrieval is not authorized. Targeted segmentation probe TR-SEG-CONTEXT-001 tested the reviewed replacements for CH-FX-DOCX-006-001. Both child inputs returned HTTP 200 with valid 384-dimensional finite vectors under truncate=false; vectors were discarded. This narrows the remaining work to deterministic corrected-corpus generation and a fresh complete embedding run.
